context: Two teens plan a culture trip
purpose: Teach: 風力/天文/観劇/醍醐味/大自然/骨董/アトラクション/カトリック教

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 修学旅行、風力発電施設、見学コースあるって。
lines.en: There's a wind-power facility tour on the school trip.
lines.style: Quick, bright announcement. Sharp intake before speaking. Leaning forward slightly — she wants him to be excited too. Pace picks up on the details.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。天文台、夜空観察もあるらしい。
lines.en: Yeah. Looks like there's also an observatory for night-sky viewing.
lines.style: Warm agreement, matching her energy without overshooting. Relaxed exhale. Lean-in acknowledgment — he's actually interested, not just going along.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 歌舞伎座での観劇、楽しみだね。
lines.en: The Kabuki-za theater visit — that'll be cool.
lines.style: Forward momentum, genuine excitement breaking through the sarcasm. Slight lift at the end like she's testing if he gets why this matters. Quick pace.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 食事の醍醐味、地元名物、満喫したい。
lines.en: I want to really dig into the local food specialties.
lines.style: Softer, more sincere than before. A small smile in the voice. Slightly slower, savoring the thought. Not performing — actually means it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 大自然のハイキングコースも、入ってるよ。
lines.en: There's a mountain hiking course on there too.
lines.style: Light, matter-of-fact delivery with underlying enthusiasm. Slight emphasis on 'mountain' — she notices he might not realize how packed this trip is. Natural pace.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 骨董店、お土産探しに寄ろう。
lines.en: We should check out the antique shops for souvenirs.
lines.style: Casual suggestion, almost thinking aloud. Relaxed tone. Small beat of hesitation before 'antique' — like he's gauging if she'd be into it. Ends gently.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: テーマパークでアトラクションも、夜入れる予定。
lines.en: Night attractions at the theme park are on the schedule too.
lines.style: Back to bright forward energy. Quick delivery. Slight breathiness — she's listing everything like she's read through the whole itinerary. Enthusiasm carrying the pace.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: カトリック教の教会も、見学に入ってる。
lines.en: The Catholic church is part of the tour as well.
lines.style: Shift to quieter, more contemplative tone. Slower pace. Slight pause before 'church' — more respectful weight to it. Trailing off softly, giving space for the moment.
